formation.explanation: the 360 lane-aligning routes remain arithmetic-consumer work; only the 2304-byte H1 boundary disappears

ma2.execution: tile A then tile B; dual formation uses a one-pair-delayed pipeline across both tiles
ma2.raw_exact_reason: identical h R2, product order, wrapped accumulation, one lambda multiply, and c-store order

phases.note: mechanical backward liveness includes the one-pair-delayed formation pipeline
each pair is validated immediately; formation is delayed one extraction so its final register is dead

scope: exact register-flow and arithmetic-preservation gate; no ASM or benchmark

terminal_contract.form: H3_EMIT_C(tile, coefficient, ymm4) immediately before each aligned final store
terminal_contract.future_h4: may replace each store hook with serializer work or store to the old h stack slot followed by one final 1728-byte copy
terminal_contract.note: the first tile cannot retain all four c vectors simultaneously because the second h quartet occupies four registers; each c_j is live at its own terminal hook
